reply.text: This is a medical stop. A head injury with memory loss and a worsening headache needs a doctor right now, not a coach. Please get emergency care or call your local emergency number now, and do not stay alone. If you have vomiting, confusion, drowsiness, slurred speech, weakness, or a fit, that is an emergency, so call straight away. Once you have been checked and cleared, I will work with you on the training side.
